item.title: Watch: Aldrich Potgieter swing theory
item.description: Take an enhanced look at the golf swing of 20-year-old PGA Tour rookie Aldrich Potgieter.

item.title: Schaper’s miracle shot earns him glory
item.description: South Africa’s Jayden Schaper hit the shot of his career to beat Shaun Norris with an eagle in their playoff and win the Alfred Dunhill Championship at Royal Johannesburg.

item.title: Watch: PGA Tour’s worst lip-outs of 2025
item.description: Check out the most soul-crushing lip-outs from the 2025 PGA Tour season, featuring players like Rory McIlroy, Ludvig Aberg and Collin Morikawa.

item.title: Novak, Coughlin win PGA-LPGA pairs event
item.description: Americans Andrew Novak and Lauren Coughlin won the PGA and LPGA Grant Thornton Invitational pairs tournament on Sunday.

item.title: Potgieter, Scheffler win PGA Tour awards
item.description: South Africa's Aldrich Potgieter has been named the PGA Tour's Rookie of the Year.

item.title: Schaper chasing back-to-back wins
item.description: Jayden Schaper arrived for this week’s AfrAsia Bank Mauritius Open still revelling in his first DP World Tour victory.

item.title: Jarvis, Jamieson lead Mauritius Open
item.description: On a tough opening day of wind and rain, the AfrAsia Bank Mauritius Open leaderboard was packed tighter than a pod of dolphins at La Réserve Golf Links.

item.title: Watch: In-depth look at Scheffler’s 2025 season
item.description: Relive Scottie Scheffler's incredible 2025 PGA Tour season through exclusive behind-the-scenes footage and interviews with Scheffler, caddie Ted Scott and his competitors.

item.title: Watch: Best of ‘Golf is Hard’ from 2025
item.description: Golf is hard, and even the best players on the PGA Tour are relatable at times.

item.title: Jarvis leads into weekend of Mauritius Open
item.description: Just before the storm rolled in, Casey Jarvis caught his own bit of lightning in a bottle and signed for a 65 to lead the AfrAsia Bank Mauritius Open.
